label: Policies
description: The house policies as rows that open.

settings.question: Cancellation
settings.answer: Cancel or move an appointment up to a day ahead at no charge. Inside a day we charge half the treatment, and the full treatment when you do not come.

settings.question: Late arrival
settings.answer: We keep your room as long as we can and finish on time for the next guest, so a late start is a shorter treatment at the full price.

settings.question: Children
settings.answer: Children are welcome in the salon with a grown-up. The treatment rooms and the studio are for over-16s.

settings.question: Gift cards
settings.answer: Gift cards do not expire and cannot be exchanged for cash. A lost card can be sent again.

settings.question: Health
settings.answer: Tell us about pregnancy, allergies, recent surgery or anything on your skin before you book. Some treatments wait until you are well.
